u001.text: Note: This advisory uses the MITRE ATT&CK® Matrix for Enterprise framework, version 19.

u002.text: See the MITRE ATT&CK Tactics and Techniques section of this advisory for a table of the threat actors’ activity mapped to MITRE ATT&CK tactics and techniques.

u004.text: (Updated Aug. 18, 2026) Since 2021, Medusa actors have used the Medusa variant to conduct ransomware attacks through at least April 2026.

u005.text: Medusa originally operated as a closed ransomware operation, meaning the same group of cyber threat actors controlled all development and associated ransomware campaigns.

u006.text: Since at least early 2023, Medusa progressed to using an affiliate model, selling RaaS to affiliates who are granted varying levels of trust based upon experience and profitability.

u007.text: For newer or less experienced affiliates, important operations such as ransom negotiation may be centrally controlled by the developers.

u008.text: Medusa actors use a double-extortion model where they encrypt victim data and threaten to publicly release exfiltrated data if a ransom is not paid.

u010.text: Medusa actors typically recruit initial access brokers (IABs) in cybercriminal forums and marketplaces to obtain initial access to potential victims.

u011.text: They offer payments between $100 United States dollars (USD) and $1 million USD to IABs, as well as the opportunity to work exclusively for Medusa.

u012.text: Most IABs, however, appear to be willing to work for multiple variants at the same time.

u013.text: Medusa actors are known to make use of common techniques, such as:

u014.text: Phishing campaigns as a primary method for stealing victim credentials [T1566].

u015.text: Exploitation of unpatched software vulnerabilities [T1190] through Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) such as:

u016.text: ScreenConnect vulnerability CVE-2024-1709 [CWE-288: Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel].

u017.text: Fortinet EMS SQL injection vulnerability CVE-2023-48788 [CWE 89: SQL Injection].

u018.text: (Updated, Aug. 18, 2026) Fortra GoAnywhere vulnerability CVE-2025-10035 [CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data].

u019.text: (Updated, Aug. 18, 2026) BeyondTrust vulnerability CVE-2026-1731 [CWE-78: OS Command Injection].
